data.narrative:
Reveal Technology is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Garrett Smith that has raised $30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the defense and security sector at similar stages.

The peer-median method is the only applicable triangulation approach, as a stage-progression methodology was rejected due to an unreliable funding-tracker base value that implied a $2.0B valuation—more than 20x the company's total capital raised. The peer-median analysis is grounded in three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). This sample yields a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median point of $400M. This relatively tight band reflects consistency across the peer set's central tendency but masks meaningful dispersion—the $4.0B outlier (Stark Defence) indicates heterogeneity within Series A defense funding. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Reveal's technology differentiation and customer traction align with the higher-valued peers versus the lower-end comparables, as well as whether the public market comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) would shift conclusions if incorporated into this primarily private-peer analysis.
